# Buzzlok AI
> The Real-Time Discovery Engine & Directory for AI Tools, Autonomous Agents, and Open Foundation Models.

## Overview
Buzzlok AI indexes, verifies, and ranks artificial intelligence software across all major domains: autonomous coding agents, deep reasoning foundation models, text-to-image/3D, generative video, voice cloning, and workflow automation tools.

## Core Categories
- **AI Agents & Autonomy** (/): Self-directed software agents with tool-calling, sandboxed browsers, and multi-step task execution.
- **Coding & Dev Tools** (/): AI pair-programming editors, codebase indexers, automated refactorers, and fullstack app builders.
- **Reasoning & LLMs** (/): Frontier hybrid and test-time compute reasoning models (Claude 3.7 Sonnet, DeepSeek-R1, OpenAI o3-mini).
- **Image & 3D Gen** (/): Real-time diffusion transformers, multi-view 3D mesh generators, and photo synthesis.
- **Video & Motion AI** (/): High-frame-rate video generators and motion controllers (Sora, Runway Gen-3, Kling, Hailuo).
- **Voice & Audio AI** (/): Low-latency voice cloning, speech-to-speech synthesis, and ambient audio generation.
- **Research & Data** (/): Deep literature synthesizers, citation analyzers, and knowledge-graph extractors.
- **Productivity & Workflows** (/): Autonomous browser automation, meeting recorders, and enterprise knowledge connectors.
- **Open Source & Weights** (/): Verified open-weights model weights, Hugging Face checkpoints, and local LLM runners.
- **Writing & Content** (/): Multilingual copywriting, marketing copy generators, and document synthesizers.
- **Music & Audio** (/): Generative music studios and multi-track audio engines (Udio, Suno).

## Key Features & Feeds
- **Live AI Radar**: Real-time autonomous ingestion from GitHub trending repositories and Hugging Face model hub.
- **Fast Natural Language Task Search**: Instant client-side intent matching for prompts like "local llm", "code editor", "reasoning", "voice clone".
- **Structured JSON-LD Schema**: Full Schema.org ItemList and WebSite definitions available at https://buzzlok.com.
